title: Chinese arrivals to see uptick at year-end
desc: The Tourism Minister said Chinese arrivals should gradually improve towards the year-end, following discussions on cracking down on scammers and strengthening tourism safety after Chinese Premier Li Qiang's visit to Thailand last week.
title_cn: 中国游客赴泰人数有望年底回升
summary_cn: 泰国旅游部长表示，在中国总理李强上周访泰期间，两国就打击旅游诈骗、加强旅游安全等议题进行深入讨论和合作。基于此次合作成果，预期中国游客到访泰国的人数将从年中开始逐步回升，年底前有望扭转近期下滑趋势，为泰国旅游业注入新活力。
desc_original: The Tourism Minister said Chinese arrivals should gradually improve towards the year-end, following discussions on cracking down on scammers and strengthening tourism safety after Chinese Premier Li Qiang's visit to Thailand last week.

title: Ministers upbeat over economic growth forecasts
desc: The latest third-quarter GDP figures and full-year economic growth forecasts from the state's planning unit show that the government is on the right track in addressing economic problems, says Finance Minister Ekniti Nitithanprapas.
title_cn: 泰国官员对经济增长前景表示乐观
summary_cn: 泰国财政部长Ekniti Nitithanprapas对国家统计部门最新发布的第三季度GDP数据和全年经济增长预测表示乐观看好，认为这些数据充分表明政府推行的经济政策措施已初见成效，国家经济发展方向正确，政策导向符合预期，有利于增强市场和投资者信心。
desc_original: The latest third-quarter GDP figures and full-year economic growth forecasts from the state's planning unit show that the government is on the right track in addressing economic problems, says Finance Minister Ekniti Nitithanprapas.

title: Ekniti vows to stay out of BoT's internal conflicts
desc: Finance Minister Ekniti Nitithanprapas has made it clear that politicians will not intervene in internal conflicts at the Bank of Thailand, saying the matter must be resolved by the central bank itself.
title_cn: 埃克尼蒂承诺不干预泰国央行内部纠纷
summary_cn: 泰国财政部长埃克尼蒂·尼提坦普拉帕近日明确表示，政治人物将不会干预泰国央行（BoT）的内部纠纷，强调此类问题应由央行自身通过正当程序解决。这一表态反映了政府对央行独立性和专业性的充分尊重，旨在维持央行在制定国家货币政策中的独立地位和权威性。
desc_original: Finance Minister Ekniti Nitithanprapas has made it clear that politicians will not intervene in internal conflicts at the Bank of Thailand, saying the matter must be resolved by the central bank itself.

title: 'Boom' faces more legal action
desc: A number of donors, including several well-known entertainers, have authorised a lawyer to pursue legal action over 3.28 million baht they contributed to the Goodness Foundation, founded by TV personality Panadda "Boom" Wongphudee.
title_cn: 「Boom」面临更多法律诉讼
summary_cn: 包括多位知名艺人在内的捐赠者授权律师，对电视名人帕纳达（「Boom」）翁布德创办的慈善机构善心基金会提起法律诉讼。涉案资金达328万泰铢，捐赠者指控相关捐款未被妥善使用。此案引发泰国社会广泛关注，对涉及的名人声誉造成重大冲击，也凸显了对慈善机构资金监管的重要性。
desc_original: A number of donors, including several well-known entertainers, have authorised a lawyer to pursue legal action over 3.28 million baht they contributed to the Goodness Foundation, founded by TV personality Panadda "Boom" Wongphudee.

title: Govt denies approving  imports of China e-waste
desc: The government has denied reports that Thailand agreed to import electronic waste from China for disposal, saying a recently approved cooperation project covers only recycling technology and training.
title_cn: 政府否认批准进口中国电子垃圾
summary_cn: 泰国政府澄清，国家并未同意从中国进口电子垃圾进行处理。政府明确表示，最近批准的中泰合作项目仅涉及电子废料回收技术开发以及专业人员培训两个方面，不包括进口外国电子垃圾的相关内容。此澄清旨在化解公众对环保问题的担忧，确保泰国的环保政策符合国际标准。
desc_original: The government has denied reports that Thailand agreed to import electronic waste from China for disposal, saying a recently approved cooperation project covers only recycling technology and training.

title: PP seeks to free SSF from govt reins
desc: The People's Party is renewing its push for an overhaul of the Social Security Fund (SSF), calling for it to be removed from bureaucratic control and managed independently, with greater oversight by contributors.
title_cn: 人民党推动社保基金脱离政府管制
summary_cn: 泰国人民党继续推动对社会保障基金（SSF）的改革计划，要求将其从政府官僚系统中独立出来，实现真正的独立管理运营。改革方案强调大幅扩大参保人员的监督权和话语权，确保基金运作更加透明公开。这一举措旨在加强对社保基金的民主治理，让广大参保者获得更多对基金事务的知情权和监督权。
desc_original: The People's Party is renewing its push for an overhaul of the Social Security Fund (SSF), calling for it to be removed from bureaucratic control and managed independently, with greater oversight by contributors.

title: Solar scheme under scrutiny
desc: The government's one-million-household solar scheme aims to accelerate Thailand's clean energy transition and reduce reliance on imported fossil fuels, but concerns over installation costs, system capacity and electricity buyback rates raise questions about its wider energy-security benefits.
title_cn: 太阳能计划面临审视
summary_cn: 泰国政府推出的百万家庭太阳能计划旨在加快国家的清洁能源转型进程，显著减少对进口化石燃料的长期依赖。然而该计划面临多重现实挑战：太阳能板安装成本高企、系统发电容量存在不确定性、电力上网价格缺乏稳定性等问题引发广泛质疑。业界和专家普遍担忧这些因素可能影响该计划对国家能源安全的实际贡献。
desc_original: The government's one-million-household solar scheme aims to accelerate Thailand's clean energy transition and reduce reliance on imported fossil fuels, but concerns over installation costs, system capacity and electricity buyback rates raise questions about its wider energy-security benefits.

title: Toxic rivers prompt demands
desc: Senators and the People's Party have urged the government to seek direct talks with China and investigate companies linked to mining in Myanmar over toxic contamination of Chiang Rai's Kok and Sai rivers, while criticising ministers for staging publicity stunts.
title_cn: 清莱河流污染引发政界质询
summary_cn: 议员及人民党呼吁政府与中国进行直接谈判，并调查与缅甸采矿相关企业对清莱府考河（Kok River）和赛河（Sai River）的污染。同时批评政府部长仅做宣传噱头而未有实质行动。
desc_original: Senators and the People's Party have urged the government to seek direct talks with China and investigate companies linked to mining in Myanmar over toxic contamination of Chiang Rai's Kok and Sai rivers, while criticising ministers for staging publicity stunts.

title: Thaksin loses bid to halt seizure of assets
desc: The Central Tax Court on Monday rejected Thaksin Shinawatra's bid to stop the Revenue Department from seizing and freezing 17 billion baht in assets to recover unpaid taxes.
title_cn: 他信资产冻结诉讼败诉
summary_cn: 中央税务法院驳回前总理他信·西那瓦（Thaksin Shinawatra）的诉讼请求。他信试图阻止税务部门查封和冻结其170亿泰铢资产以追缴欠税，但未获法院支持。
desc_original: The Central Tax Court on Monday rejected Thaksin Shinawatra's bid to stop the Revenue Department from seizing and freezing 17 billion baht in assets to recover unpaid taxes.

title: Impact planning to build 25,000-seat indoor arena
desc: Impact Exhibition Management is planning a new 25,000-seat indoor arena and expects to secure investors by the first half of 2027.
title_cn: Impact集团计划兴建大型室内竞技场
summary_cn: Impact Exhibition Management集团规划建设新型25000座室内竞技场，预计将于2027年上半年前完成融资。该项目将为曼谷增添重要体育场馆设施，承办大型体育赛事和活动。
desc_original: Impact Exhibition Management is planning a new 25,000-seat indoor arena and expects to secure investors by the first half of 2027.

title: Thai mutual funds set to hit double-digit growth
desc: Thailand's mutual fund industry is expected to grow by double digits in 2026, marking a strong recovery after several subdued years, as investors increasingly seek overseas investment opportunities to diversify their portfolios amid market volatility.
title_cn: 泰国基金行业增速望破两位数
summary_cn: 泰国共同基金行业2026年有望实现两位数增长，标志着在经历多年沉寂后的强劲复苏。随着市场波动加剧，投资者越来越多地寻求海外投资机会来分散投资风险。
desc_original: Thailand's mutual fund industry is expected to grow by double digits in 2026, marking a strong recovery after several subdued years, as investors increasingly seek overseas investment opportunities to diversify their portfolios amid market volatility.

title: 泰国政府紧急辟谣！内阁从未批准接收中国垃圾入境
desc: 泰国头条新闻社讯 11月16日，据泰媒报道，泰国总理府副发言人拉莉达就社交媒体上流传的“政府与中国合作、把泰国变成全球工业垃圾处理场”等信息作出澄清。她表示，上述说法不属实，系将部分信息片面关联造成误读；内阁从未作出任何允许从中国或其他国家进口垃圾来泰国处理的决议。 拉莉达介绍，2026年10月27日，内阁通过了“澜沧江—湄公河合作框架特别基金”项下协议草案，其中一个项目为“提升回收产业能力以支持循环经济与绿色产业”，由工业经济办公室负责执行，期限18个月。该项目旨在发展汽车电池、太阳能电池板及电子垃圾的管理与回收方面专业知识，并制定适当监管方针，并非从国外进口垃圾的项目。 拉莉达强调，发展回收领域专业知识，不等于允许从国外进口垃圾，二者性质完全不同。协议草案中没有任何条款要求泰国必须接收来自中国或任何国家的垃圾进行处理，本次内阁决议也没有批准把泰国变成全球工业垃圾的接收地。 她补充说，泰国现行法律已禁止进口特定类别的电子垃圾，走私违禁品属于违法行为。总理阿努廷领导的政府高度重视电子垃圾问题，着力以切实举措提升对走私进口的管控与打击力度，包括核查进出口、检查高风险工厂，以及研究完善法律措施，提高对违法者的处置效力，涵盖相关法律规定的民事责任与刑事处罚，并要求污染制造者对所造成的损害负责。 拉莉达表示，政府理解民众对电子垃圾影响的担忧，但发展回收领域专业知识，对于未来应对报废电池及电子设备十分必要，有助于泰国高效、环保地处理废弃物，并非为外国向泰国倾倒垃圾打开通道。 她表示，监督政府是民众的权利，政府也愿意倾听各种担忧，但新闻报道必须建立在正确、完整的事实基础之上，不应片面歪曲信息、制造社会恐慌。信息的准确性与对社会的责任，比网络上的热度更重要。 拉莉达重申，政府并没有把泰国变成世界垃圾倾倒场的政策，而是在推进废弃物管理专业知识发展的同时，认真提升对非法垃圾进口的打击力度，以保护民众健康、环境及国家利益；并呼吁各方在发布信息前先核实事实，以免给民众造成不必要的误解与焦虑。 （编译：Wan；来源：PPTVHD36） The post 泰国政府紧急辟谣！内阁从未批准接收中国垃圾入境 appeared first on 泰国头条新闻 .

title: Thailand orders mileage records to curb second-hand car odometer tampering
desc: Thailand orders mileage records to curb second-hand car odometer tampering Legacy Thailand’s Transport Ministry has ordered the Department of Land Transport (DLT) to draw up a standard way of recording the mileage of second-hand cars before sale, aiming to stop odometer tampering . The plan came out of a meeting with used car dealers today, November 16, and the ministry has not yet given a method or a start date. Deputy Transport Minister Siripong Angkasakulkiat gave the instruction after talks with Wisut Hemphanphairoh, president of the Used Car Operators Association, and members of the association, with DLT representatives also at the table. The association had asked for the meeting to discuss how a car’s accumulated mileage could be declared before it goes on sale. Siripong asked the DLT, which handles vehicle registration and issues the car registration book, to agree on measures with the association that would record mileage to a set standard and give a clearer picture than the registration book does. title: Thailand to take Myanmar mine pollution concerns to talks with China
desc: Thailand to take Myanmar mine pollution concerns to talks with China Legacy Thailand will take its concerns about pollution from Myanmar mines to talks with China from today, November 16, after Deputy Interior Minister Jeset Thaiset inspected the Doi Ko Wan mining area across the border from Chiang Rai on November 14. He said the mines are still expanding near streams that flow into the Sai River, and the talks with China run to November 18. Jeset viewed the Shan State sites from Ban Phaya Phrai in Thoet Thai subdistrict, Mae Fa Luang district, having previously followed them on satellite images. He said a large area of land remains available for the mines to grow, close to villages and to streams that run into the Sai River, which could affect people living all along the waterway. The Nation reported that he saw at least 10 more cleared sites at Doi Ko Wan and nearby Mong Kan, and that he estimated the mines could double in size within a year. title_cn: 缅甸矿污染扩大威胁流域 泰国将在中泰谈判提出
summary_cn: 泰国内务副部长杰塞于 11 月 14 日视察清莱对面掸邦 Doi Ko Wan 矿区，发现矿区大幅扩张且持续增长，污水排放威胁流入赛河（Sai River）的溪流生态，可能影响下游数十个村庄居民用水安全。泰国将在 11 月 16-18 日与中国的谈判中正式提出此议题，要求中方关注并制止污染进一步扩大。
desc_original: Thailand to take Myanmar mine pollution concerns to talks with China Legacy Thailand will take its concerns about pollution from Myanmar mines to talks with China from today, November 16, after Deputy Interior Minister Jeset Thaiset inspected the Doi Ko Wan mining area across the border from Chiang Rai on November 14. He said the mines are still expanding near streams that flow into the Sai River, and the talks with China run to November 18. Jeset viewed the Shan State sites from Ban Phaya Phrai in Thoet Thai subdistrict, Mae Fa Luang district, having previously followed them on satellite images. He said a large area of land remains available for the mines to grow, close to villages and to streams that run into the Sai River, which could affect people living all along the waterway. The Nation reported that he saw at least 10 more cleared sites at Doi Ko Wan and nearby Mong Kan, and that he estimated the mines could double in size within a year. title: 泰航两项安全动态引关注，客机因故障备降，4架波音787将受检
desc: 泰国头条新闻社讯 据泰媒报道，11月16日，泰国国际航空公司一架从德国慕尼黑飞往泰国曼谷的空客A350-900客机因技术故障临时备降印度新德里。泰航已为受影响旅客安排住宿，并于周一派遣特别航班前往新德里接回滞留旅客。 泰航表示，发生故障的是11月14日执行慕尼黑至曼谷航线的TG925航班，该航班于当地时间当天下午1时35分从慕尼黑起飞。在飞行过程中出现技术问题，机长出于安全考虑，决定将飞机临时备降新德里，确保乘客和机组人员的安全。飞机随后安全降落，所有乘客均平安。 事故发生后，泰航为受影响旅客安排了住宿，并于11月16日派出TG8479特别航班，执飞新德里至曼谷航线接回滞留旅客。根据计划，该航班于当地时间上午11时30分从新德里起飞，预计于曼谷当地时间下午4时55分抵达。 此前，美国联邦航空管理局发布适航指令，要求波音787“梦想客机”运营商检查机翼中央燃油箱的密封材料。该指令指出，由于飞机制造过程中的质量控制环节存在已识别的缺陷，有必要对相关密封材料进行检查，确保飞行安全。泰航16日宣布，将根据美国联邦航空管理局（FAA）的要求对旗下4架波音787“梦想客机”的燃油箱密封材料进行检查。 根据要求，相关检查须于2026年12月7日至2030年12月7日期间完成。不过，美国联邦航空管理局并未要求相关飞机在检查完成前停飞。泰航计划在旗下4架波音787客机进行定期深度维修保养时，同步完成相关检查工作。 （编译：hansa；审核：wan；来源：bangkokpost） The post 泰航两项安全动态引关注，客机因故障备降，4架波音787将受检 appeared first on 泰国头条新闻 .

title: 曼谷湄南河灯光节攻略来了！7大观赏点、无人机及烟花时间全整理
desc: 泰国头条新闻社讯 这个年末，曼谷将再添一抹璀璨亮色。2026年湄南河灯光艺术节定于11月13日至12月13日在湄南河畔举办，为期一个月。活动以灯光、色彩、声效、多媒体及烟花秀点亮两岸地标，带游客从另一个角度感受曼谷的夜间魅力。所有公共灯光秀均免费观赏，游客可在河畔、码头、公园及湄南河步道自由观看。 每天6场常规灯光秀，7大亮点点位 活动期间，即便在没有特别节目的日子，游客也可每天在湄南河两岸的7个亮点点位观赏灯光声效表演，每天6场，时间为19:00、19:30、20:00、20:30、21:00和21:30，贯穿11月13日至12月13日全程。 特别表演亮点与日程 在常规灯光秀之外，多个河畔点位还将上演烟花、无人机字幕及泰国文化等特别节目，主要看点如下： Rama VIII Bridge（拉玛八世桥）将呈现瀑布水幕烟花配合灯光声效，演出日期为11月12、13、20、27日及12月4、11日，20:45开始； Wat Arun（郑王庙/黎明寺）带来恢弘的无人机字幕表演，日期为11月12、13、18、20、25、27日及12月2、4、9、11日，19:50开始； Wat Kalayanamit（甘拉亚纳米寺）上演灯光声效与泰国文化表演，日期为11月12—15、20—22、27—29日及12月4—6、11—13日，每天两场，分别为19:20和20:20； Phra Phutthayotfa Bridge（Memorial Bridge）与Krung Thep Bridge则献上璀璨烟花秀，日期为11月12、13、20、27日及12月4、11日，20:45开始。 两类观演点位，提前了解更从容 组委会提醒，观演点位分为两类。第一类为”专属表演点位”，在表演时段不直接对外开放入内，游客可从对岸、邻近观景点或游船上观赏，包括Wat Arun、Pom Wichai Prasit、Royal Thai Navy办公楼及海军礼堂连接桥、The Langham Custom House Bangkok（朗廷海关大楼酒店）、Samray Church No.1、Lhong 1919废弃楼、Nakkharaphirom Park、Thammasat University（Tha Phra Chan校区）、Bank of Thailand，以及Khlong Bangkok Noi与Khlong Dusit运河口一带（Siriraj Hospital）；此外，Asiatique Charoen Nakhon Pier同样在演出时段不开放入内。 第二类为”可观赏灯光的河畔地标”，包括Krung Thep Bridge、Phra Pok Klao Bridge、Phra Phutthayotfa Bridge、Rama VIII Br

title: 普吉芭东突发大火致11人死亡！总理阿努廷海外致电指示全力救援
desc: 泰国头条新闻社讯 据泰国媒体报道，11月16日凌晨，普吉芭东发生严重火灾，造成多人伤亡。正在菲律宾马尼拉出席东盟峰会的泰国总理阿努廷第一时间致电普吉府府尹了解事故最新情况，要求当地各部门全力救助伤者，同时尽快查明起火原因，依法严肃处理相关问题。 11月16日，泰国总理阿努廷在菲律宾首都马尼拉出席东盟峰会，得知普吉芭东发生重大火灾后，阿努廷第一时间致电普吉府府尹，了解事故最新情况并对事故中受伤人员及受影响居民表达关切。 阿努廷要求府尹协调当地各相关部门，包括行政部门、警方、消防部门、公共卫生部门及救援机构，全力救助伤者、楼内住户以及可能仍被困在建筑内的人员，同时做好周边区域的安全保障工作，防止事故造成进一步影响。 与此同时，阿努廷要求有关部门加快调查火灾原因，迅速果断地处理相关问题。如果调查发现管理疏漏或存在安全隐患，必须彻底查明，并依法追究相关责任。 据悉，火灾于当天凌晨约3时17分发生，起火地点为普吉芭东一家摩托车租赁店，随后火势蔓延至附近商业楼，共有4间商铺受到影响。消防人员经过约2小时的扑救，最终控制住火势。 目前，相关部门正继续跟进事故后续工作，包括调查起火原因、核查建筑受损情况，并为伤者及受灾人员提供必要协助。 （编译：jinda；审校：wan；来源：mgonline） The post 普吉芭东突发大火致11人死亡！总理阿努廷海外致电指示全力救援 appeared first on 泰国头条新闻 .

desc: 泰国头条新闻社讯 11月15日，在第49届东盟峰会期间，东盟领导人共同见证了《东盟数字经济框架协议》（ASEAN Digital Economy Framework Agreement，简称DEFA）文件移交东盟秘书长。这标志着东盟数字经济一体化进程取得重要进展。值得注意的是，协议实际签署仪式于11月14日在菲律宾马尼拉举行，15日进行的是文件移交环节。 泰国副总理兼商业部长素帕琪表示，泰国在本次协议谈判中发挥了重要作用，作为DEFA谈判委员会主席国，泰国与东盟各成员国密切协调，推动自2023年启动的谈判于2026年取得成果。接下来，泰国将加快国内批准程序，并与其他成员国协调，争取推动协议于2027年年中正式生效。 素帕琪指出，DEFA旨在解决东盟各国数字法规、技术标准和数字系统存在差异的问题，通过建立共同规则和标准，推动成员国数字系统互联互通，减少跨境商业活动中的重复手续和交易成本。 从具体内容来看，协议涉及无纸化贸易、电子支付、数字身份验证等多个领域。通过推动相关系统衔接，企业未来有望减少纸质文件提交、重复身份核验及跨境支付中的操作环节，让数字交易更加便捷。此外，协议还涵盖人工智能（AI）、数据创新、海底电缆合作以及数字产品非歧视原则等新兴议题，并通过监管沙盒机制，为科技初创企业和中小企业提供测试创新产品与服务的空间。 对于泰国而言，DEFA的潜在受益范围并不局限于科技行业。数字内容、游戏、软件、旅游、农业、金融及物流等领域，都可能从区域数字规则的协调中获得新的发展机会。尤其是中小微企业（MSMEs），如果能够以更低的成本进入其他东盟国家市场，将有机会扩大客户来源，提升区域竞争力。 不过，协议能否真正转化为企业经营层面的便利，仍取决于后续实施情况。 对于一家希望将游戏、软件、旅游服务或农产品销售到东盟其他国家的泰国企业而言，跨境交易不仅涉及产品和服务本身，还包括订单确认、身份核验、支付结算、电子单据认可及售后服务等多个环节。即使电子支付实现互通，如果物流单据仍需重复录入，或者不同国家对电子文件的认可标准不一致，企业依然需要承担额外的时间和运营成本。 与此同时，跨境数字交易规模扩大，也意味着消费者保护、个人数据安全、网络诈骗防范及交易纠纷处理等问题更加重要。如果退款机制、数据使用规范和责任认定不够清晰，即使交易流程更加便捷，也未必能够充分建立消费者信任。 另一个值得关注的问题是中小企业的实际参与能力。大型企业通常拥有专业的数字化团队和成熟的跨境业务系统，而许多小型商家仍面临语言服务、产品数字化、网络安全及跨境运营经验不足等现实困难。因此，协议实施后的配套培训和企业服务，不能仅停留在政策介绍层面，还需要帮助商家了解如何完成跨境签约、收款、单据处理及售后服务，让企业真正具备进入区域市场的能力。 在经济增长预期方面，素帕琪援引波士顿咨询公司（BCG）的研究指出，

title: Suvarnabhumi cargo backlog drags on despite 115 extra staff
desc: Suvarnabhumi cargo backlog drags on despite 115 extra staff Legacy The Thai government has set out five measures to clear the cargo backlog at Suvarnabhumi International Airport, including 115 extra warehouse staff, 30 more forklifts, explosives-detection dogs and more storage space at Bangkok’s main airport. A new working group of state and private-sector representatives will report progress to the transport minister every 15 days. Deputy Government Spokesperson Ploythalay Laksamisaengchan announced the plan today, November 16, after the agencies involved met on the orders of Deputy Prime Minister and Transport Minister Phiphat Ratchakitprakarn. She said the delays were hurting both Thai exports and imports. The meeting found three causes, she explained: X-ray scans cannot clearly check dense export cargo, so staff must open it or use sniffer dogs; import storage is so crowded that workers cannot locate shipments ; and staff and machines are shared between inbound and outbound goods. title: Thailand needs 26,000 more EV chargers as holiday queues build, says operator
desc: Thailand needs 26,000 more EV chargers as holiday queues build, says operator Legacy Thailand needs about 26,000 more public EV chargers to keep up with soaring electric car numbers , charging operator SHARGE estimated last week, naming motorway rest stops and holiday routes as the worst bottlenecks . The company put the national ratio at about 30 cars per public charger, against a global average of about 11. Peerapat Sirichantaropas, chief executive of Sharge Management Co Ltd, said Thailand had more than 5,000 public charging stations with about 15,000 chargers between them, for a cumulative fleet of more than 456,000 battery-electric vehicles (BEVs) registered by the end of September. DC fast chargers were the weakest link, at about 47 cars for each one, and in many areas there were not enough of them for everyday use. The company estimates that the country needs 2.7 times as many public chargers as it has now, about 41,000 in total, to keep pace with growth. Its figures show 169,638 BEV registrations in the first nine months of 2026, up 93% on the same period last year, after 122,384 for the whole of 2025, a rise of 72.12% on 2024. title: WORPT app lets tourists spend crypto in Thailand via PromptPay, Visa Prepaid Card
desc: WORPT app lets tourists spend crypto in Thailand via PromptPay, Visa Prepaid Card Legacy International tourists can now spend crypto in Thailand through WORPT, a new app that converts cryptocurrency into Thai baht for everyday payments via Thai QR PromptPay . WORPT has officially launched under the Tourist DigiPay Regulatory Sandbox. The app aims to grow its user base among international tourists, with a projected 150,000 active users. WORPT projects that about 15 billion baht in digital asset purchasing power will be converted into baht and channelled into Thailand’s tourism sector and wider economy over 18 months. The team also expects the app to create opportunities to distribute about 1.95 billion baht in income to local businesses and small and medium-sized enterprises (SMEs) over the 18-month participation period. How the Tourist DigiPay sandbox works The Tourist DigiPay Regulatory Sandbox is overseen by Thailand’s Securities and Exchange Commission (SEC). It lets digital asset business operators test cryptocurrency-to-baht conversion services over an 18-month period. Police and forensic officers are examining a possible short circuit at an electricity pole outside the building, and the cause has not been confirmed. The alarm was raised at about 3.15am local time on Phang Muang Sai Kor Road in Patong subdistrict, Kathu district, and Patong Municipality firefighters said they reached the scene within about five minutes despite heavy rain. Six fire engines brought the blaze under control after about an hour, while rescue volunteers from the Kusoldharm Phuket Foundation helped bring people out of the building. desc: 泰国头条新闻社讯 据泰国媒体报道，11月16日凌晨，普吉芭东镇发生严重火灾，一栋6层商业楼陷入火海，火势迅速蔓延至两侧相邻建筑，共有3栋建筑受到影响。截至目前，事故已确认造成11人死亡。 当地时间11月16日凌晨3时15分左右，消防部门接到报警，称芭东镇一栋6层商业楼发生火灾。该建筑底层经营摩托车租赁业务，起火后，建筑正面及内部迅速陷入火海，随后火势蔓延至两侧相邻的商业楼。 芭东镇副镇长表示，事故发生时当地正下雨。初步推测，火灾可能由电线杆电路短路引发，电线产生火花后，火星落入附近的摩托车停放区域，进而引燃车辆，导致火势迅速扩大。 由于建筑一楼停放着100多辆摩托车，现场还有汽油、轮胎及塑料零部件等易燃物，火势因此迅速蔓延并产生大量浓烟，烟雾扩散至整栋建筑。 该建筑上层用作住宿。火灾发生后，楼内人员试图向更高楼层撤离，以躲避火势和浓烟，但部分人员未能逃脱。救援人员随后在3楼发现1名遇难者，在5楼发现另外10名遇难者，目前确认死亡人数为11人。与此同时，救援人员也全力营救其他受困人员，获救者大多平安。 芭东镇副镇长表示，市政府在凌晨约3时接到报警后，救援人员约5分钟内抵达现场，并调派6辆消防车展开灭火行动。然而，由于现场停放大量摩托车，车辆内的燃油、轮胎等物品助长火势，灭火工作十分困难，现场浓烟密布，消防人员耗时约1小时才控制住火势。 目前，芭东镇政府工作人员及普吉善德堂基金会救援人员仍在现场展开全面排查，确认是否还有其他伤亡人员。相关部门也将进一步调查火灾造成的损失及具体起火原因。 （编译：jinda；审校：wan；来源：mgronline） The post 普吉芭东突发大火！6层商业楼起火，11人死亡 appeared first on 泰国头条新闻 .
